The season that comes after autumn is winter.

The author's narrative style in the provided text is characterized by a third-person objective point of view. The narrator observes the detective's actions and speech without entering his internal thoughts or offering personal judgment, instead reporting on the observable qualities of his narration, such as his "meticulous attention to detail" and "clinical detachment." The tone of the text is analytical and appreciative yet restrained. It mirrors the subject matter by maintaining an objective stance while acknowledging the effectiveness of the detective's straightforward, unembellished language. The style is formal and precise, avoiding emotional language to reflect the clinical nature of the detective's approach.
